name: agent-monitor
description: Universal real-time agent observability. One plugin for ChatGPT/Codex desktop, Codex CLI and Claude Code: lifecycle hooks push normalized events to a local-only dashboard (activity, tools, tokens, errors, compaction, permissions).

interface.longDescription: Streams session, tool, model-request, token, compaction and permission events to a bundled local server bound to 127.0.0.1. ChatGPT/Codex uses :17894, Claude Code :17892. Open http://127.0.0.1:17894 (or :17892 for Claude). No data leaves the machine.
defaultPrompt: Open the Agent Monitor dashboard and summarize current agent activity.
